# Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA)

```{r}
library(psych)

## item-level data for EFA
efa_dta <- fct_dta |> dplyr::select(ci_1:ewb_10)
```

## Parallel analysis

```{r}
## run a parallel analysis
parallel_analysis <- fa.parallel(efa_dta, n.iter = 100)
```

- pmfe items are highly correlated with fa items.
- 

```{r}
efa_items_selected_dta <- efa_dta

set.seed(8341)
parallel_result <- fa(
  efa_items_selected_dta, 
  nfactors = 6,
  fm = "ml",
  fa = "fa", 
  rotate = "oblimin",
  show.legend = TRUE
)

print(parallel_result$loadings, cut = 0.3, sort = TRUE)
```

## Factor extraction

```{r}
## extracting factors suggested by the parallel analysis, with
## oblique rotation since the underlying constructs are expected to be correlated
efa_6factor <- fa(
  efa_dta,
  nfactors = 6,
  fm = "ml",
  rotate = "varimax"
)

print(efa_6factor$loadings, cut = 0.3, sort = TRUE)
```


# PLS-SEM

```{r}
library(seminr)

## measurement model
measurement_model <- constructs(
  composite("CI",   multi_items("ci_", 1:9)),
  composite("PMFE", multi_items("pmfe_", 1:7)),
  composite("FA",   multi_items("fa_", 1:4)),
  composite("FS",   multi_items("fs_", 1:5)),
  composite("HII",  multi_items("hii_", 1:4)),
  composite("EWB",  multi_items("ewb_", 1:10))
)

## structural model
structural_model <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("CI", "FA", "FS", "HII"), to = "PMFE"),
  paths(from = "PMFE", to = "EWB"),
  paths(from = c("CI", "FA", "FS", "HII"), to = "EWB")
)

## estimate PLS-SEM
pls_model <- estimate_pls(
  data = fct_dta,
  measurement_model = measurement_model,
  structural_model = structural_model,
  missing = mean_replacement,
  missing_value = NA
)

summary_pls <- summary(pls_model)
```

## Measurement model

### Reliability tests

```{r}
## reliability and convergent validity
summary_pls$reliability
```

### Validity tests
```{r}
## discriminant validity (Fornell-Larcker criterion)
summary_pls$validity$fl_criteria
```

### Multicollinearity tests
```{r}
## collinearity (VIF)
summary_pls$vif_antecedents
```


## Structural model

Two competing structural specifications are estimated for comparison: one where CI, FA, FS, and HII have **direct paths only** to EWB, and one where **PMFE mediates** the relationship between those factors and EWB (in addition to retaining the direct paths).

```{r}
## structural model: direct paths only (PMFE not mediating CI/FA/FS/HII,
## but still included as a direct predictor of EWB)
structural_model_direct <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("CI", "FA", "FS", "HII", "PMFE"), to = "EWB")
)

pls_model_direct <- estimate_pls(
  data = fct_dta,
  measurement_model = measurement_model,
  structural_model = structural_model_direct,
  missing = mean_replacement,
  missing_value = NA
)

summary_pls_direct <- summary(pls_model_direct)
```

```{r}
## structural model: PMFE as mediator (plus direct paths, as originally specified)
structural_model_mediated <- relationships(
  paths(from = c("CI", "FA", "FS", "HII"), to = "PMFE"),
  paths(from = "PMFE", to = "EWB"),
  paths(from = c("CI", "FA", "FS", "HII"), to = "EWB")
)

pls_model_mediated <- estimate_pls(
  data = fct_dta,
  measurement_model = measurement_model,
  structural_model = structural_model_mediated,
  missing = mean_replacement,
  missing_value = NA
)

summary_pls_mediated <- summary(pls_model_mediated)
```

### Direct-effects model

```{r}
## bootstrap for significance testing
set.seed(4827)
boot_pls_direct <- bootstrap_model(
  seminr_model = pls_model_direct,
  nboot = 5000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1
)

summary_boot_direct <- summary(boot_pls_direct, alpha = 0.05)
plot(boot_pls_direct)
```

```{r}
DT::datatable(summary_boot_direct$bootstrapped_paths |> round(3))
```

```{r}
## R-squared
DT::datatable(summary_pls_direct$paths |> round(3))
```

### Mediated model (PMFE as mediator)

```{r}
## bootstrap for significance testing
set.seed(4827)
boot_pls_mediated <- bootstrap_model(
  seminr_model = pls_model_mediated,
  nboot = 5000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores() - 1
)

summary_boot_mediated <- summary(boot_pls_mediated, alpha = 0.05)
plot(boot_pls_mediated)
```

```{r}
DT::datatable(summary_boot_mediated$bootstrapped_paths |> round(3))
```

```{r}
## R-squared
DT::datatable(summary_pls_mediated$paths |> round(3))
```
